spreadsheet_id.segment: Configured via Actions settings as spreadsheetId; referenced per-action mapping
spreadsheet_id.rudderstack: Configured via destination config as sheetId; used in Sheets API v4 Values.Update and Values.Append calls
spreadsheet_id.parity: Equivalent — both reference the same Google Sheets spreadsheet ID

sheet_name.segment: Sheet/tab name configured per Actions mapping subscription
sheet_name.rudderstack: Configured via destination config as sheetName; used as range prefix (e.g., 'SheetName!A1')
sheet_name.parity: Equivalent — both target a named sheet tab within the spreadsheet

column_mapping_strategy.segment: Actions-based architecture with configurable field mappings per subscription; each mapping defines source event field path to destination column name
column_mapping_strategy.rudderstack: eventKeyMap array in destination config; each entry has 'from' (source event field path) and 'to' (destination column header name); Transformer resolves paths and produces positional attributeKey/attributeValue pairs
column_mapping_strategy.parity: Functionally equivalent but architecturally different — Segment uses UI-driven Actions mappings while RudderStack uses eventKeyMap config array processed by external Transformer service

header_row_handling.segment: Column headers defined by Actions mapping field names; managed automatically by the Actions framework
header_row_handling.rudderstack: Header row written explicitly via spreadsheets.values.Update at range SheetName!A1; first column is always 'messageId' followed by eventKeyMap[].to values; header written once with double-check locking pattern (isHeaderUpdated flag)
header_row_handling.parity: Gap — RudderStack always inserts 'messageId' as the first column; Segment column order is defined entirely by the Actions mapping configuration

message_id_column.segment: messageId is included only if explicitly mapped in the Actions configuration
message_id_column.rudderstack: messageId is always the first column in every row (hardcoded in header row construction and parsed from transformer output at position 0)
message_id_column.parity: Gap — RudderStack forces messageId as column 0; Segment treats it as optional

data_format.segment: Structured row data with column names matching the Actions mapping destination fields; values are typed per the source event field
data_format.rudderstack: Transformer produces numbered positional map (0, 1, 2, ...) with attributeKey/attributeValue pairs; producer resolves each position to a cell value; supports Number and String types via gjson.Type switch
data_format.parity: Equivalent output row format — both produce a flat row of values appended to the spreadsheet; internal transport format differs

batching.segment: Actions framework handles batching internally based on subscription configuration
batching.rudderstack: Supports batch mode via 'batch' array in transformer output; multiple messages appended in a single spreadsheets.values.Append API call with multiple rows
batching.parity: Equivalent — both support multi-row batch appends to reduce API calls

authentication.segment: OAuth 2.0 flow managed by Segment UI; user authorizes Google account access during destination setup
authentication.rudderstack: Service account JSON credentials (JWT) configured in destination config as 'credentials' field; creates OAuth2 client via google.JWTConfigFromJSON with SpreadsheetsScope; also supports test mode with explicit AccessToken/RefreshToken and custom endpoint
authentication.parity: Gap — Segment uses user-facing OAuth2 authorization flow; RudderStack uses service account (JWT) credentials requiring manual setup

api_method.segment: Google Sheets API v4 — specific method depends on Actions implementation
api_method.rudderstack: Google Sheets API v4 — spreadsheets.values.Update (header row at SheetName!A1) and spreadsheets.values.Append (data rows at SheetName!A1) with ValueInputOption RAW
api_method.parity: Likely equivalent — both use Sheets API v4 for row operations

error_handling.segment: Actions framework standard retry with exponential backoff
error_handling.rudderstack: Maps googleapi.Error to HTTP status codes; handles context.DeadlineExceeded as 504; returns structured error messages with [GoogleSheets] prefix for logging
error_handling.parity: Functionally equivalent error semantics; implementation details differ

numeric_type_preservation.segment: Type handling depends on Actions mapping configuration
numeric_type_preservation.rudderstack: Explicit numeric type preservation: gjson.Number type values are stored as float64 via attrValue.Float(); all other types stored as string via attrValue.String()
numeric_type_preservation.parity: RudderStack explicitly preserves numeric types in spreadsheet cells; Segment behavior depends on mapping configuration

notes: Google Sheets shared stream destination. Segment slug: actions-google-sheets. RudderStack package: services/streammanager/googlesheets/. RudderStack implements GoogleSheetsProducer conforming to common.StreamProducer interface. Key architectural difference: Segment uses Actions-based configurable mappings while RudderStack uses eventKeyMap config processed by external Transformer into positional attributeKey/attributeValue pairs. Parity gaps: (1) RudderStack hardcodes messageId as first column, Segment treats it as optional; (2) authentication model differs — RudderStack uses service account JWT vs Segment user-facing OAuth2; (3) header row management differs — RudderStack uses explicit Update call with double-check locking. Both platforms ultimately produce equivalent flat row data appended to the target spreadsheet via Google Sheets API v4.
